locator: Published paper pp.385–386, section3.9.4, Table8; PDF pages8–9
inspectedText: Section3.9.4 and Table8 describe Barbados needing a two-goal victory over Grenada to qualify. The sudden-death extra-time goal counted double. At a 2–1 lead Barbados deliberately conceded to tie and reach extra time. Grenada could then qualify by scoring at either end; Barbados defended both goals, retained the tie and scored the extra-time winner. The paper's date heading says25January1994 and location saysSt.George's; RSSSF records27January and Bridgetown. These discrepancies must be reconciled, not silently copied. The analysis is original scholarly work; its historical account is retrospective, not an eyewitness match report. No primary tournament rulebook, full match film or contemporary official report was inspected.
